headlines.title: Pope Leo slept well after cancer surgery, but recovery could take ‘longer than expected’
headlines.description: Peru’s president said the 71-year-old American pontiff’s planned visit might be in jeopardy as he recovers from surgery to remove part of his right lung.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: Pope Leo Shares First Message After Lung Cancer Surgery
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV is on the mend two days after surgery for adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer. The 71-year-old pontiff shared a first message saying he is “grateful for the outpouring of support” and asking them to “keep praying” as he recovers. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY from Rome.

headlines.title: Rising cancer rates in the spotlight across Iowa midterm races as voters focus on water
headlines.description: Roughly two in five Iowans will be diagnosed with cancer in their lifetimes. It's a big concern for many voters, and now, it's at the center of debates ahead of the midterms. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Pope Leo recovers after lung surgery
headlines.description: There are new details about Pope Leo’s recovery following his lung cancer diagnosis. Doctors say he is progressing as expected. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports from Rome.

headlines.title: CVS to Pay $315 Million Settlement Over Opioid Prescriptions
headlines.description: CVS has agreed to pay a $315 million settlement to resolve a Justice Department case over allegations it illegally filled opioid prescriptions. The settlement resolves a 2024 lawsuit accusing the healthcare giant of providing controlled substances to fuel its own profits at the expense of public health and safety. CVS says it disagrees with all claims made and does not admit any wrongdoing.

headlines.title: Home Depot’s holiday sweater is back — grab it before it sells out again
headlines.description: Home Depot’s limited-edition holiday sweater sold out in minutes. It restocks today with over $200 in tools for $29.99. Here’s how to buy it.

headlines.title: A comprehensive marathon gear checklist, made by pro-runners for beginners
headlines.description: I asked 7 professional runners about their marathon essentials for training, racing and recovery. This is the gear they can’t live without, and tips for beginners.

headlines.description: We tested hundreds of skin care products, and our editors narrowed down their favorites that don’t irritate their skin. Shop the best sensitive skin products from Cerave, Kiehl’s, Clinique, La Roche-Posay, Dove and more.

headlines.description: How to lower blood pressure naturally with food. Cardiologist explains why beets are the best vegetable to manage hypertension and prevent stiff arteries.
